body:
# Lifesteal Public SMP Resource Pack

A custom resource pack created exclusively for Lifesteal Public SMP, designed to enhance the server's gameplay experience with custom textures and visual improvements. Built from the ground up to match the server's style while remaining lightweight and easy to use.

## Features
- Custom textures and item appearances
- Enhanced visual experience for Lifesteal Public SMP
- Optimized for multiplayer gameplay
- Made specifically for use on the server

# Requirements

## ⚠️ This pack requires a CIT (Custom Item Textures) mod variant to work properly.⚠️ 

### Supported CIT implementations include mods such as:

- Variants CIT (Fabric)
- OptiFine (OptiFine-compatible installations)

# Credits
